name: design-os-apple
description: Native Swift 6.2 & SwiftUI component system, adaptive color engine, and multi-platform specimen verifier for iOS 26, iPadOS 26, and macOS 26.

interface.shortDescription: Native Swift 6.2 & SwiftUI component system, adaptive color engine, and multi-platform specimen verifier for iOS 26, iPadOS 26, and macOS 26.
interface.longDescription: Ship HIG-compliant SwiftUI interfaces with semantic tokens (`DesignOSAdaptiveColor`), Liquid Glass & tactile depth, Dynamic Type safety, and automated simulator specimen verification.
defaultPrompt: Build a native SwiftUI settings and telemetry screen using DesignOSApple semantic tokens, 44pt minimum hit targets, and Dynamic Type.
Audit our SwiftUI views against the Apple HIG gate for hardcoded colors, missing accessibility labels, and Reduce Motion fallbacks.
Run the portable contract verifiers for quickstart parity, app style registry, and layered UI-kit specimens.
